entities.name: Kazuhiro Yamauchi

entities.summary: Kazuhiro Yamauchi  was a Japanese baseball player and manager. He played for the Mainichi Orions, the Hanshin Tigers and the Hiroshima Toyo Carp over the span of an 18 season-long career (1952–1970).
